### Risks

- A compliant full team may exceed live capacity; queuing must preserve logical identity, isolation and one-to-one review. Never reduce the required team to make the demonstration pass.

### Acceptance criteria

- Receipts prove a real manager distinct from the host and all required function instances, exact model/effort parity, actual role reads, packet versions and source-authority boundaries.
- Generic uses one worker; complex uses independent solvers and a distinct senior; extra-complex has one distinct reviewer per solver and current passes before senior fusion.
- Exercise a rejected candidate revision, a shared synthesis conflict with all required re-review, one analysis-only outcome and an authorized dedicated-implementer coding outcome.
- Include queued solvers, missing/stale evidence, capacity handling, user steering, and a main task with mixed categories. Unavailable native evidence leaves the corresponding requirement incomplete.

### Planned verification

- Capture actual spawn/message/wait/interrupt results with runtime IDs, sent packet digests, role digests and current artifact versions, excluding hidden reasoning and raw transcripts.
- Directly inspect delivered changes, manager acceptance, implementation ownership and criterion results; compare them with deterministic fixture expectations.
